desc:
Survive another day in the world worst town. Dig through trash and other questionable things, rob the bean shop and other activities to slowly crawl out of poverty.

Created, developed, and maintained by @1lia_a.

- Enhanced version of Backstreet Survival, continued by its original developer under Hoshineko Studio.
- Development moved here after the original community was removed. Legacy remains at version 3.0.
